label: Contingent truths have sufficient reasons
summary: The support edge uses the pinned Latta translation of §32, which states the general sufficient-reason principle. The distinction of contingent truths in §33 and application in §36 are context. §§37–38 are further context on a final reason beyond the contingent series.
blocker: The principle in §32 requires a sufficient reason for the truth in question, even when unknown. Show that a world-indexed contingent existent gives rise to a fact in this source scope and that its sufficient reason supplies a token for that very existence fact in the model’s explains relation.
